description: This Dart source file defines the CachedContentRepository class, which implements a cache-decorated content repository with SWR semantics for a Flutter app. It manages data fetching, caching, and cache invalidation for content feeds, content details, and search results, including background refresh and cache busting mechanisms.

classes.name: CachedContentRepository
classes.description: A cache decorator for the content repository implementing SWR semantics, managing cache logic for content feeds, details, and search results with background refresh and cache invalidation.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed payload, utilizing cache if fresh or stale, and triggers a background refresh.

methods.name: _refreshHomeFeed
methods.description: Performs background refresh of the home feed cache.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves content details by ID, using cache if available, and refreshes in background.

methods.name: _refreshDetails
methods.description: Performs background refresh of specific content details.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query, using cache if available, with background refresh.

methods.name: _refreshSearch
methods.description: Performs background refresh of search results for a query.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgress
methods.description: Records the current playback position for a content ID in the database.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks playback as completed for a content ID.

methods.name: getPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the saved playback progress for a content ID.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Retrieves recent watch history entries from the database.
